//: Deliberately declares no serena. Serena reaches sessions through bin/serena-relay.cjs, which joins or starts one shared Serena per repository. The plugin declares it in .claude-plugin/mcp.json with a ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} path. Sessions in this repository without the plugin get it from the user-scope entry `claude mcp add serena -s user -- node ~/.claude/bin/serena-relay.cjs` (SETUP.md step 5). A serena here would be project scope. That scope expands variables only from Claude Code's own environment, and the server's CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and cwd are both the directory the session started in. So a path here cannot reach the relay from a subdirectory. Project scope also outranks user scope, so the broken entry would shadow the working one. hooks/test/verify-all.cjs fails if serena is added back here.
